messages.author: e1aa1f1044f2548f
messages.subject: dateInput with "limited choices"
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to allow for user input, where the date choice is restricted to the first day of the third month of a quarter.

Right now I have:

DateInput("variable", "Date:", value="2013-03-01", startview="year")

Unfortunately, it allows the user to select any day or month during the quarter. Is there a possibility to reduce the date choices to, say, 2013-03-01, 2013-06-01, 2013-09-01 etc.? Or, does anyone have a clever idea how to accomplish this? Otherwise I will just have to convert the choice to the nearest "permissible" date...

Many thanks,

Philipp
